- Build a complete, playable 3D volleyball game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-based Three.js game with an AI opponent, first-to-11 scoring, keyboard and touch controls, and a responsive interface.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game in `index.html`, including a 3D court, players, ball physics, CPU returns, scoring, and match restart.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Checked the game in Chromium and captured desktop and mobile screenshots; verified the game had no console errors after play began.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
